lanes.summary: Data follows the Apple ID through Health: the standalone Watch app and the iPad app read Health data synced via iCloud, and workout photos sync via iCloud. Premium can be shared with up to 5 people through Family Sharing. Sharing with people is a one-way image card through the share sheet, and whether app settings (character, units, status) sync between devices is undocumented.
